patthana9.14:1.1: Nokilesaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nanokilesaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…. Nasaṃkilesikaṃ
patthana9.14:3.1: nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naasaṃkilesikaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…. Nasaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ
patthana9.14:4.1: nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naasaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana9.14:6.1: Nakilesasampayuttaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nakilesavippayuttaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana9.14:8.1: Nakilesañceva naasaṃkilesikañca nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naasaṃkilesikañceva nano ca kilesaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana9.14:10.1: Nakilesañceva naasaṃkiliṭṭhañca nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… naasaṃkiliṭṭhañceva nano ca kilesaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nakilesañceva nakilesavippayuttañca nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nakilesavippayuttañceva nano ca kilesaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… (sabbattha nava, vipākaṃ natthi).
patthana9.14:11.1: Kilesavippayuttaṃ nasaṃkilesikaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… kilesavippayuttaṃ naasaṃkilesikaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
